about: Inside volumes to cross-check against a CAD kernel. Lengths in mm, volumes in litres. Expected values are the closed forms, checked by an independent shoelace/slicing sum in shapeCrosscheck.test.ts. The wedge cases are also confirmed independently by FreeCAD (wedge_check.py, freecad-wedge.json).

cases.note: Worked example: slope front, butt joints. theta 68.459 deg, inside depth 355.543 (bottom) / 219.754 (top). The (D_avg - 2T) shortcut gives 75.9538 L.
36 mm (double) sloped baffle, 18 mm walls, theta 63.435 deg.

Tapered (all sides): every wall tapers evenly, walls taken square to each sloping face. A one-slope wedge entered this way reads about 0.2% high (the taper is split between front and back): use the wedge shape for those.
